resolution.summary: Fixed false Interrupted labels by separating task status, worker activity and recorded host lifecycle. Added Response recorded, Inactive and explicit interruption/failure/paused handling without inferring fulfillment or verification. Terminal observations are compact checkpoint metadata; stale known turn IDs cannot stop newer requests. Exposed lifecycle in dashboard/CLI/task reads, preserved unfinished code and explicit completion rules, refined generated suggestion classification, and updated owned instructions. Added 13 lifecycle regressions and a read-only audit. Audit: 71 project roots, 1,959 tasks, 504 legacy unclosed records and 469 generated-work candidates; no historical statuses or evidence changed. Clean package and syntax checks passed; browser QA covered synthetic states and confirmed the original OpenOffice request now shows Inactive, interrupted=false, with no fabricated resolution/evidence. Installed 0.4.4, updated 99 worktree instruction sets, preserved 2 linked instruction sets, restarted service and verified all 36 installed source/dashboard files match. Documented docs/task-lifecycle.md and CHANGELOG. Commit 0a1fbe8 and tag v0.4.4 pushed to origin.
